items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...is that Tatz... Do you know if he started on that?... [INTERVIEWEE] I don't believe, I... I don't believe. I think he used to play the album system.

ctx.x: Polga and Claiborne. Used to meet there.

I was gonna ask, you mentioned Alexander, is that Tatz, the young... That's Tatz. Because his father played in the brass bands too. Tatz, I understand uses, if I remember, uses the BAME system, clarinet now. Do you know if he started on that? I hadn't talked to him yet. In those days when you took his place, was he playing that or the...
I don't believe, I... I don't believe. I think he used to play the album system.
